bestBets.overview: Strong winds predicted from the North West and Northerly direction so headwind 1500m start, tail wind 600m. PASSIO went really well on debut when chasing home odds on favourite, but stuck on well with a good margin to third, and winner had good profile. INDEPENDANT LAD has had three runs 1200 to 1300m so has a foundation to handle the rise to 1500 on home track. Lost margin at start was about same as margin on the line. IMABADGUY has jumped out well in two 1200m hit outs which is a good setup for 1500m debut. EL FERDINANDO ran on nicely in 1000 Caulfield Heath jump out. FOXTROT CHARLIE gets forward but from wide barrier but wind may have some impact. TOP CONTI suited if wind dries track to a Soft 5.

raceTips.comment:
Passio ran well on debut behind the favourite Cignetti, who is early favourite for the opening race at Sandown on Saturday. He gapped third when narrowly beaten, is open to natural improvement and can either lead or race prominently to the speed. 
Foxtrot Charlie went forward and was plain last start at Geelong however he's hard fit and his previous form would see him the main danger to the favourite. He's drawn wide but can roll forward to offset the barrier.

bestBets.overview: KOORALBYN jumped out nicely at Traralgon in a two horse war with Classic Secret who placed behind super impressive debut winner Over Excited and Icelady, who is Group3 placed. Thought he was going well on the line in jumpout. HIERACHY worked into Caulfield Heath 1000m jump out nicely inside the last 300m and looks ready to run well. This ties in with MYKINDAKANDY, who has been gelded,  who was given a rev up to be ready for his return to racing in Hierachy jumpout. Looked sharp in previous jump out on Pakenham synthetic when untested. SATOSHI appreciated the drop in grade when resuming on firmer synthetic surface at Ballarat. Gets good run from draw. Forgive ABSENT synthetic run last start. Went very well on turf at Geelong behind progressive type.

raceTips.comment:
Kooralbyn has shown ability in a recent jumpout. He interestingly makes his debut off only the one jumpout this preparation and has attracted plenty of early market support. If he's fit enough he looks a great chance on debut. 
Fellow debutant Hierarchy has also jumped out well enough to win on debut without surprising.
Satoshi led and looked the winner first up before tiring late. He strips fitter and gets a big positive jockey change with Lachie Neindorf taking over from an apprentice.

bestBets.overview: HAUTE hasn't been tested in recent jump outs and latest was under a big grip by Ben Melham who rides on race debut here. KOKO has been in excellent touch and just missed winning last start, but didn't get room when she needed it earlier. Has form on firmer tracks and will get good run from inside draw. LITTLE RICHO resumes, but looked an improver with race experience. Green on debut and in latest placing stayed inside where quinella came out wide. FLAMINGO FLYER made up a stack of late ground in Pakenham synthetic return and was no surprise to see he produced the best last 200m of the meeting. One to throw in the exotics at big odds. REMILIK showed pace to win Caulfield Heath jump out on soft5

raceTips.comment:
Haute looks well placed to win on debut. Jockey Ben Melham couldn't have held her much slower in her recent jumpout. She's drawn wide but that likely just means he can put her where he wants in running and she shouldn't have any road blocks. 
Koko brings the pick of the race form. She has a strong starting price profile and plenty of race experience. She had every chance last start and found one better and maps for a similar run here.

bestBets.overview: COME TOGETHER travelled boldly in front in debut and Bendigo and despite being run down late was still five lengths in front of third placegetter. Winner had jumped out well. Should relax a bit more with race experience and way shorter straight here suits. QUEEN SERENA has looked sharp winning two jumpouts this time in. Led and won in a canter and then was asked and responded to run on in latest. THE TROUBLESHOOTER was grabbed late on the Pakenham synthetic track last start and peaks after three runs. Stakes placed as a juvenile over this trip. OXFORD STREET ran excellent race in town to place over this trip on debut. Peaked at 200 in 1200m last start, so suited over 1000m here.

raceTips.comment:
Queen Serena particularly caught the eye winning a Flemington jumpout from last in March. She's jumped out well under light riding twice this preparation and looks to have plenty of talent. 
Masochistic was heavily backed on debut at Sale in a potentially strong maiden and was left with a lot to do on a tough day to make wide sweeping runs. She maps to potentially settle closer from an inside barrier. 
Come Together started $2.50 on debut on the back of an impressive jumpout. The heavy 10 might have been a bit too wet for him but he did gap third and can improve onto a firmer surface.

bestBets.overview: SHE'S MY EX ran well in Adelaide two starts back when just caught over 1050m then tried stakes class. Much better placed here over 1000m with the 3kg claim. BELLA CINQUE has had two runs in town this preparation, but they have been on heavy tracks. Ran well in midweek metro BM70 over the trip at Sandown Hillside. SUPERLIV looked sharp winning 800m jump out at Flemington. She as a history of a poor run,  then spell and bouncing back, so last run looks like and end of preparaton effort. Norton bit comes off so intention will be to let her run. BLONDIE'S AWARD has won last two starts around this distance and last start was brave winning after sitting wide without cover.

raceTips.comment:
A tough race. She's My Ex has strong form and a strong starting price profile for a race like this. Her latest jumpout was very quiet however she moved nicely. She has the tactical versatility to race forward or take a sit depending on the early speed.
Legacy Bel recorded an upset win in a stronger race three starts ago before a good run in a stronger race in the wrong part of the track at Sandown. I can easily ignore her last start on a bottomless track she likely didn't handle.

bestBets.overview: RAZANNE was good through the line when placed over 1717m at Sale, top three finishing clear of the rest,  so the increase in distance will suit this lightly raced runner who has foundation of two runs at 1600m and further. FOIX has improving fitness levels and put writing on the wall working to the line at the end of 1717m second up. Showed promise 2000m + last preparation. TOLPUDDLE has bee knocking on the door in recent starts at Pakenham on the synthetic track, the latest in decent time. Last time on turf in better side of soft range was only beaten 2.26l in same class by The Grumpy Bear. Jamie Melham stays on board. OMANORI was running solid races in 2400m races in town and had flat run when dropped back to similar distance range. Form profile is of a horse who does like turning tracks at Moe and Cranbourne. Entitled to another chance.

raceTips.comment:
Foix ran a much improved race second up where he looked arguably a bit unlucky not to finish closer. He appears significantly better suited rising in distance third up from a spell and finds a suitable race where he can potentially settle closer to the speed. 
Tolpuddle's recent form and last start SP read well for this. He should get a soft run and might now be looking for this distance. A track any worse than a Soft 6 would be a concern.

bestBets.overview: STAY HUMBLE has placed in both starts over this trip and can hold a forward position which is a major help on this track. Best onpacer over this trip last start and winner Ocean Bay has made it two wins in a row. Placed here at 1200m so knows the layout. CROWN CRUSHER caught the eye late when resuming over shorter trip and has good metro midweek ratings in 66 grade.Distance suits. CORONATIONHERCULES didn't have the clearest of passages in the straight last start in field with good depth. Found the line nicely so extra distance is a positive. TWISTED LOVE is the interesting runner changing stables and states. Bedggood does produce them with high fitness levels first up. Winner over 1800m in BM64 class on Good 4, so not worried about being run off feet in 1000m jumpout on heavy ground that he hates, but trialled like you would expect from a stayer. DOLCE CAROLINA broke the field up when winning over 1400m from the front last start on Pakenham Synthetic track, but has bold 1459m close up second in decent time on Soft 5 turf. Suited turning Mornington circuit. WASHINGTON LILAC was tried in Group 3 company in Sydney in the Autumn when finding winning form over 2124m in previous start so the 1500m fresh seems logical. Looked the the sort who improve with time.

raceTips.comment: Coronationhercules came from a long way back to win his maiden two starts ago with ear muffs on, beating two horses in second and fourth that have both since won twice. He was then excellent in defeat at Sale last start where he raced wide without cover against the pattern early, before he was checked and then lost momentum and galloping room in the home straight. Hen then picked himself back up and hit the line strongly. He's drawn to potentially get the galloping room he needs and gets blinkers on for the first time which could really switch him on.

bestBets.overview: CATTLE CAMP resumes, but was impressive winning on debut and runner up has won three races since. Straight to midweek metro company and found line nicely. Jumped out well when locked togther with Gr3 winner Snow Mercy who won Sandown Hillside BM78 on Wednesday. INSAIN HARRY looks ready for a bold showing first up from last start placing in higher grade in midweek metro company at Caulfield Heath behind King Tut who has won Saturday metro BM70. Won first-up last preparation and had a good hitout in Flemington jumpout behind talented galloper Cruiserweight. IRONIC FORTUNE races forward so well served from inside barrier. Drove hard to win in last stride last start. TSARINE has a strong 1200m record and was a bit keen last start, and has a rider can get them to switch off.

raceTips.comment:
Cattle Camp won impressively on debut last preparation before hitting the line strongly at Caulfield Heath in a race he wasn't far behind subsequent Saturday class winner Milos Filos. He's jumped out nicely ahead of his return and looks well placed to resume with a victory pending his fitness given he's had only one jumpout. 
Mauna Kea Miss looks much better placed here than in her recent starts dropping back in distance, down in class and with blinkers going back on.
